text:
jon-ops: Heads up — noticed a quiet uptick in page-retire hints and row-remap counters on pool20 over the last 48h. Not spiking Xid errors yet but trending. graph: https://graf.redwood/pool20/gpu_mem_remap
maria-sre: Can you paste the tail of the NVML logs for one of the affected cards?
jon-ops: sure, small snippet from gpu-20-03:
```
> NVML: Page retirement triggered: 0x1a4
> NVML: Remap entries: 312 -> 328
> ECC corrected: 124 -> 139
```
ashley-infra: thanks. pool20 has had version 470.63 rolled last week — any correlation with firmware/driver rollouts?
kevin-hw: we pushed driver 470.63 -> 471.12 for some hosts two days ago, but pool20 was partially held back. need to map which nodes ran which.
jon-ops: i'm running a quick grep now, but initial mapping shows affected cards are mixed across firmware versions (both 470 and 471).
monitoring-bot: ALERT: mem.page_retire_rate > baseline (pool20) for 48h :eyes: (incident id INF-3421)
sre-oncall: @maria-sre please triage, low severity for now but could worsen. Any customer-facing impact?
maria-sre: No user errors or job retries reported so far. Latency & OOM rates unchanged. Suggest marking these GPUs for observation + enable continuous mem scrub on them.
nashley-infra: Agreed. Plan: tag impacted GPUs, add to soft-drain watchlist, and run extended mem-test during next maintenance window. If remap count increases > 20% in 24h -> schedule physical replacement. :white_check_mark:
jon-ops: created INF-3421 and added asset list. quick sample of affected cards: gpu-20-03, gpu-20-07, gpu-20-14, gpu-20-21.
kevin-hw: I'll validate ECC counters at hardware level and check for any DIMM firmware notes. If it's mixed firmware and cards nearby are healthy, could be early memory cell degradation.
maria-sre: Also correlate with workload placement — these are mostly long-sequence batching jobs. Could be repeated large seq length wear. Enable prefix KV caching to reduce repeated full-context token expansion on those hosts for the short term.
jon-ops: toggled caching suggestion on routes for pool20. Will monitor.
sre-oncall: For tracking: please add the per-card time series to the group dashboard and create a short-runbook: steps to drain, memtest commands, ticket template for RMA.
nashley-infra: I'll draft the runbook and link it in INF-3421. memtest command we use: `python infra/tools/gpu_memtest.py --duration 4h --verify`
jon-ops: scheduling extended memtest for gpu-20-03 at 02:00 UTC. I'll post results in the thread. Thanks all. :pray:
